summary: Turned the specialist positioning from week 1 into a Fund III narrative. Agreed a three-part story, a lead proof point from Fund II returns and an off-market sourcing message. A published point of view on special educational needs consolidation is still being considered.

discussion.keyPoints: Natalie said LP feedback from Fund II was that the deck was dense and the sourcing story got lost. Richard said 9 of the 11 Fund II deals were sourced off-market, which hardly features.
Fund II is at 2.1x gross MOIC and 24% gross IRR with three realised exits. Richard wants realised exits up front.
Richard has a strong view on consolidation in special educational needs provision. Natalie worried that publishing it could unsettle a portfolio company's local authority clients.

recommendations.recommendation: Lead with: sector specialists in regulated healthcare services and education, with 9 of 11 Fund II deals sourced off-market.
Tell a three-part story: regulated sectors with steady demand, buy-and-build platforms, and measurable social outcomes.
Open the track record section with Fund II at 2.1x gross MOIC and 24% gross IRR, showing the three realised exits first.
Publish a point of view paper on consolidation in special educational needs provision ahead of launch.

actions.action: Redraft the first ten pages of the Fund III deck around the three-part story

nextFocus: Plan the LP outreach programme and channel mix for the raise.
nextPreparation: Bring the full LP target list with current relationship owners.
